reviews.title: Fun! But Absolutely time wasting

I love this game! When my friends and I are bored, we play it all the time and never get bored. There is a complaint.
When i first started to play the game, I would have no one to play it with. So i played the bot npc. I won the first time, but then i got really mad. Why? Because even when i would put the bot npc on easy mode, it would beat me everytime. Like hello? I am in 6th grade, and computers are only as smart as the humans who programed them, aka total DUNCES!!!! It would beat me everytime. Its really unfair. Plus i feel like blue always wins, even when its not an npc. Fix this, bro!!!!
